Load data
```{r}
counts = read.delim("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/TIPIT_RNA_TPM_134.txt")
clinical = read.delim("~/Documents/LungPredict_late_stage/Data/Captier/TIPIT_reponse_134.txt")
```

Processed data
```{r}
counts = counts %>%
  dplyr::select(-GeneID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = T) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene_name")

clinical = clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = as.numeric(counts[1,])) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("patient_ID")
  
counts = counts[-1,rownames(clinical)]
```

Log normalized
```{r}
counts.norm.log = log(counts + 1)
```

Gene sets
```{r}
genesets = readRDS("group_marker_genesets.rds")
sig_scores = compute.pathway.activity(counts.norm.log, gene_sets = genesets)[[2]]
patient_group <- apply(sig_scores, 1, function(x) names(which.max(x)))
clinical$group = patient_group
```
Function for survival analysis
```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(features, survival.data, time_unit, p.value = 0.05) {
  library(survival)
  n_features <- ncol(features)
  significant_combinations <- list() # To store significant feature combinations
  
  # Prepare the data for survival analysis
  data_for_model <- data.frame("time" = survival.data$PFS,
                               "status" = survival.data$PFS_bin,
                               "response" = survival.data$Progression) 
  
  data_for_model$coxHL <- survival.data$group

  # Perform Kaplan-Meier based on coxHL
  km_fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ coxHL, data = data_for_model)
  
  pval <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit, data = data_for_model)$pval #Performs log-rank test to see whether both survival curves are significantly different
  
  ### Set colors of each curve with the correct order 
  strata_names <- gsub("coxHL=", "", names(km_fit$strata)) 
  legend_labels <- strata_names
  legend.labs = legend_labels

  pdf("Results/SurvPlot_DEG_groups", width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
  print(survminer::ggsurvplot(km_fit,
                   data = data_for_model,
                   size = 1,
                   conf.int.style = "step",
                   pval = TRUE,
                   risk.table = TRUE,
                   risk.table.col = "strata",
                   legend.labs = legend.labs,
                   risk.table.height = 0.3,
                   ggtheme = theme_grey(),
                   title = paste0("Cox PH for Surv(time, status) ~ patient groups"),
                   xlab = paste0("Time to death/recurrence/progression (", time_unit, ")")
  ))
  dev.off()

}
```

Compute survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(sig_scores, clinical, "months", p.value = 1)
```
